title: CourseAsCode Folder Activity
description: Schema for FLD_*.yaml Folder activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be FOLDER (case-insensitive)

Description.description: Short description shown on the course page

VisibleToStudents.description: Whether the folder is visible to students (default: true)

DisplayDescription.description: Show the description above the file list (default: false)

YamlFilePaths.description: Relative paths to FILE_*.yaml files to include in this folder
